Definition: to suspend in a balance, i.e. weigh
BiblicalUsage: çâlâʼ is simply to weigh in a balance. Scripture uses it in Lamentations, and the context leaves nothing to guess at.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that çâlâʼ is no exception: no word in Scripture is filler.
